subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose message-tool channel creation for Slack and Discord, and under what default-off operator/admin authorization boundary?
rationale: Channel creation lets agents mutate workspace/server structure, so implementation needs maintainer intent on scopes, requester identity, and whether message.action's current operator.write boundary is sufficient.

options.title: Approve default-off provider-owned admin actions
options.body: Implement channel creation inside each provider plugin with explicit action gates, setup scopes, requester checks, docs, and targeted tests.

options.title: Limit scope to Discord CLI parity first
options.body: Land or replace the open Discord CLI subcommand work while leaving Slack and cross-provider admin actions blocked until a later decision.

options.title: Reject native channel creation for now
options.body: Keep channel provisioning external to OpenClaw until a stronger admin policy surface exists.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider-owned admin actions
recommendation.body: Implement channel creation inside each provider plugin with explicit action gates, setup scopes, requester checks, docs, and targeted tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already reviewed this exact issue surface and is the strongest routing candidate for the authority/product boundary decision.
